description: This file defines the IOSGatewayChatTransport struct which implements the OpenClawChatTransport protocol for iOS. It manages chat sessions, sending messages, requesting chat history, health checks, and handling real-time events via a gateway session.

classes.name: IOSGatewayChatTransport
classes.description: A struct that conforms to OpenClawChatTransport and Sendable, managing chat transport functions over an iOS-specific gateway session.

methods.name: abortRun
methods.description: Aborts an ongoing chat run session given a session key and run ID.

methods.name: listSessions
methods.description: Lists chat sessions with optional limit.

methods.name: setActiveSessionKey
methods.description: Stub method for setting active session key; no operation for operator clients.

methods.name: requestHistory
methods.description: Fetches chat history for a given session key.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message with optional attachments, logs the operation, and returns the response.

methods.name: requestHealth
methods.description: Checks the health status of the gateway.

methods.name: events
methods.description: Returns an async stream of real-time chat events from the gateway.
